Tooltip_CA_BowStave: Needs a bowstring of twisted sinew or twine.
Tooltip_CA_Bow: Quiet. Trains Aiming. Reload readies up to 5 arrows; the next one is nocked after each shot.
Tooltip_CA_Arrow: Arrows that hit a zombie can often be pulled from its corpse.
Tooltip_CA_RestringBow: Replaces a worn string. Arrows readied on the bow are lost.
